stemMd: A city argues that a temporary bike-lane trial should precede a permanent redesign, just as a theatre uses rehearsals before a public performance. Which difference most limits the analogy?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Actors and cyclists are different people.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The trial itself can change travel habits, so conditions during the permanent scheme may differ from those during the trial.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Theatre tickets can be sold online.

explanationMd: The analogy relies on a preliminary exercise predicting later performance. If the exercise changes the system being predicted, its observations may transfer imperfectly. Superficial differences between theatre and transport do not address that logical role.

distractorRationale.e: Ticket sales are unrelated to rehearsals' predictive value.
distractorRationale.a: The construction material is not the relevant contrast.
distractorRationale.d: This is a similarity, not a limiting difference.
distractorRationale.b: Different participants do not undermine the relevant testing relation.
